## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.14.1

### 📷 Cameras
- Restores the Home Assistant native WebRTC signal relay path for X-Sense live camera view.
- Removes the Python media bridge from live camera startup so camera playback no longer depends on a local `aiortc` media stack.
- Keeps X-Sense WebRTC ticket and signaling handling inside the vendored `python_xsense` adapter while Home Assistant only handles WebRTC answers and candidates.

### 🧪 Safeguards
- Updates the camera regression checks so future changes keep the signal relay path and do not drift back to the Python media bridge.
